id.instruksi: Robot belum lengkap. Dengarkan tempat yang kosong, lalu sentuh bagian tubuh yang harus dipasang.
id.t-kepala1: Robot belum punya kepala. Bagian mana yang dipasang di tempat yang kosong?
id.t-kepala2: Di atas badan robot masih kosong, tempat mata dan mulut. Bagian mana yang dipasang?
id.t-kepala3: Robot mau melihat dan berbicara, tapi bagian paling atasnya kosong. Bagian mana yang dipasang?
id.t-badan1: Robot belum punya badan. Bagian mana yang dipasang di tempat yang kosong?
id.t-badan2: Bagian tengah robot masih kosong, di antara kepala dan kaki. Bagian mana yang dipasang?
id.t-tangan1: Robot belum punya tangan. Bagian mana yang dipasang di tempat yang kosong?
id.t-tangan2: Robot mau memegang bola, tapi sisi badannya masih kosong. Bagian mana yang dipasang?
id.t-tangan3: Robot mau melambai, tapi kiri dan kanan badannya kosong. Bagian mana yang dipasang?
id.t-kaki1: Robot belum punya kaki. Bagian mana yang dipasang di tempat yang kosong?
id.t-kaki2: Robot mau berjalan, tapi bagian paling bawahnya kosong. Bagian mana yang dipasang?
id.t-kaki3: Robot mau melompat, tapi di bawah badannya masih kosong. Bagian mana yang dipasang?

en.instruksi: The robot is not finished. Listen to which place is empty, then touch the body part it needs.
en.t-kepala1: The robot has no head yet. Which part goes in the empty place?
en.t-kepala2: The top of the robot's body is empty, where the eyes and mouth go. Which part goes on?
en.t-kepala3: The robot wants to see and talk, but its very top is empty. Which part goes on?
en.t-badan1: The robot has no body yet. Which part goes in the empty place?
en.t-badan2: The middle of the robot is empty, between the head and the legs. Which part goes on?
en.t-tangan1: The robot has no arms yet. Which part goes in the empty place?
en.t-tangan2: The robot wants to hold a ball, but the sides of its body are empty. Which part goes on?
en.t-tangan3: The robot wants to wave, but the left and right of its body are empty. Which part goes on?
en.t-kaki1: The robot has no legs yet. Which part goes in the empty place?
en.t-kaki2: The robot wants to walk, but its very bottom is empty. Which part goes on?
en.t-kaki3: The robot wants to jump, but below its body is empty. Which part goes on?

itemCount.keterangan: tiga pilihan per pertanyaan: satu bagian tubuh benar, sisanya bagian lain atau alat
